Subject: MAP starter slab + slide deck for Lighthouse Labs pilot

Hi team / Olivia —

Attaching a very compact MAP "starter slab" (Google Doc) and a lightweight slide deck v0 to get the Lighthouse Labs pilot scoped and scheduled. The goal here is to give them a 30-day pilot runway we can reliably measure: tech validation + acceptance criteria + cost/throughput expectations.

What I want from the internal side this week:
- Ben: quick pass on acceptance criteria + security checklist (one pager) — can you add inline comments in the doc by EOD Tue?
- Jonas: suggested slide owners and a 30-day milestone timeline (draft on slide 3) — can you take that and attach a kickoff agenda?
- Marissa: commercial framing + pilot T&Cs (credits, pricing floor) — a short paragraph in the deck would be great.

Olivia — sharing early so you and procurement can see the proposed milestones. If anything in the attached looks off from your side (timeline, data residency, or KPIs), tell us now and we'll adjust. Proposed next touch: quick sync Wed 7/2, 10:00-10:30 PT.

Attachments (stubs): MAP-starter-slab.gdoc (draft), MAP-slide-deck-v0.pptx

Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/placeholder-MAP-starter-slab
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/LL-2025-1314

Thanks —

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>

Subject: Re: MAP starter slab + slide deck for Lighthouse Labs pilot

Thanks for the draft, Jas — nice tight starting point. A couple of quick notes (I'll add inline comments in the doc):

- Acceptance criteria: recommend we make the acceptance binary and measurable (3 checks): 1) model latency with 95th pct < 350ms on their test set, 2) correctness on eval set (F1 > 0.78), 3) integration with their ingestion pipeline (end-to-end sample run).
- Security: add a short "data flow" appendix describing where logs are retained and who can see them. If they require SOC2 evidence we'll point them at our public SOC2 artifacts but call out any gaps for the pilot.
- SLOs: let's propose a 99.5% successful completion rate for scheduled runs during the pilot window.

I'll finish comments by Tuesday afternoon. Also +1 on the Wed 7/2 sync — works for me.

- Data residency: for the pilot we need logs retained in US only. Can you call that out specifically in the MAP (where you asked about logs)?

Following up with a suggested slide responsibility matrix and a tentative milestone timeline:

- Slide owners (v0):

  - Technical approach & infra reqs: Jonas
  - Security & data handling: Ben (appendix)
  - Commercials & credits: Marissa
  - Acceptance checklist & next steps: Jasmine + Marissa

- Proposed pilot timeline (short):
  - Week 0: kickoff + environment prep (access, test dataset load)
  - Week 1: baseline experiments + perf baseline
  - Weeks 2-3: iterative tuning, integration checkpoints
  - Week 4: acceptance run + close/next-steps decision

I've attached a short kickoff agenda (kickoff-agenda.gslides stub) and added a first-pass agenda to the doc. Also, for procurement: I'll draft a one-paragraph pilot liability note and drop into the MAP doc — Ben, happy for you to vet security language.
